pilot_decision.reason: Treatment preserved the existing action and useful core, made only two small calibration corrections, avoided public machinery, and more completely removed unsupported numerical authority than control.

interpretation: Lolla pressure may add value as calibration and restraint even when it should not change the user's action.
The pressure packet did not force a model parade, checklist, new decision tree, or wholesale rewrite.
This is one sample and a Codex-assisted provisional read; it is not evidence of reliable stand-down behavior.
The positive pilot and quiet pilot together suggest that the next product target is not more extraction recall but discriminating when pressure is uniquely useful and when it should stay small.
